title: You Think Eyes Stream One Moving Movie, Yet Losing One Brain Spot Freezes Tea Like Ice
description:
You think your eyes film life as one smooth movie! Yet losing one brain module freezes pouring tea solid! This is the true story of Munich scientist Josef Zihl's patient. Here is what went wrong in a German kitchen.
